name: tests-50pct-watchtower-container-selector-expressions
instr:
Watchtower cannot target container updates with one composable selector across names, images, labels, scope, enabled state, and Watchtower identity. Implement a validated selector policy for configured scans and authenticated HTTP updates without changing targeting when no selector is supplied.

Expressions support typed equality comparisons, `!`, `&&`, `||`, and parentheses. Negation binds before conjunction, then disjunction. Compilation rejects malformed syntax, unknown fields, invalid operators, and incompatible literals before evaluation. Syntax errors have stable messages and byte offsets.

All filterable container representations use the same typed selector truth model. Docker-backed containers expose inspection labels and cached identity fields without mutation. Programmed filter mocks expose exactly their configured metadata and preserve unavailable values. Lightweight sorter containers derive metadata from inspection data, with deterministic fallback when unavailable. Equivalent fields retain each representation's native storage behavior. Resolved configuration retains the selector source and compiled immutable program, giving repeated projections and scans identical semantics.

Intersect selectors with legacy name, image, label, enable-label, and scope policy. Keep expression-free behavior unchanged. Evaluate the immutable selector against listed inventory before pulls, stops, restarts, cleanup, or lifecycle hooks. Preserve dependency precedence, Watchtower-last or
